title: Assessment Receipt Schema
description: Structured, tamper-evident assessment receipt (SW-157-ASSESS-001). A receipt represents an available or unavailable assessment result, the full 40-hex SHA of the subject under assessment, the sources inspected, the commands and their exit codes, the findings, the explicit limits of the assessment, the provenance of the assessor, and a sha256 content digest over the canonical receipt. Unknown keys are rejected at every level so a misspelled or smuggled field can never be silently ignored, and a recomputed digest is required so any post-hoc mutation of a digested field fails closed.

schema_version.description: Receipt schema version. Only v1 exists.

status.description: available = the assessment ran and produced a decision; unavailable = it could not be completed and must be read with its limits.

summary.description: Optional one-line statement of the assessment outcome.

full_sha.description: Canonical lowercase full 40-hex SHA of the immutable subject under assessment.

sources.description: Ordered sources inspected. Order is significant and digested.

sha256.description: Canonical lowercase sha256 of the source content as inspected.

commands.description: Ordered commands run and their exit codes. Order is significant and digested.

findings.description: Ordered findings. Order is significant and digested.

limits.description: Explicit limits of the assessment: what it could not establish.

digest.description: Canonical lowercase sha256 over the receipt with this field excluded; recomputed and compared on ingestion.
